# Ehoro Village
> Ehoro Village builds practical AI workflows, dashboards, assistants and training systems for teams that need technology people will actually use. Based in the New York area; works remotely across the United States.

## Services (https://www.ehorovillage.com/services.html)
- AI workflow automation (Python, n8n, Zapier, with AI steps where they help)
- Dashboards and reporting (Google Sheets, Excel)
- Custom AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude) with documents, rules and review steps
- AI training and adoption: hands-on sessions, plain-language AI policies, 30-day follow-up

## How projects are handled
Scoped in writing · tested against real examples · documented with a plain-language guide · human-reviewed. Clients never share passwords.
